cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(r36_stereo_compare VERSION 0.5.1 LANGUAGES CXX)
if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Comparison resource measurements require Linux (/proc and getrusage)")
endif()
option(R36_COMPARE_WITH_HORIZON "Enable the genuine Horizon stereo model provider" ON)
option(R36_COMPARE_BUILD_TESTS "Build comparison contract tests" ON)
set(COMPARE_RUNNER_INSTALL_DIR "lib/perception_ros_so_demo" CACHE STRING "Comparison executable install destination")
find_package(OpenCV REQUIRED COMPONENTS core imgproc imgcodecs)
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../cmake/nv12.cmake")
if(NOT TARGET perception::sdk)
  find_package(perception_full_shared_sdk CONFIG REQUIRED)
endif()
add_executable(r36_compare_runner src/main.cpp)
target_sources(r36_compare_runner PRIVATE ../../features/camera/src/mo_camera.cpp)
target_include_directories(r36_compare_runner PRIVATE ../../features/camera/include ../../features/camera/vendor/mo ../../core/include)
target_link_libraries(r36_compare_runner PRIVATE ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
if(NOT TARGET platform_metrics)
  find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
  add_library(platform_metrics STATIC ../../features/metrics/backend/src/platform_metrics.cpp
    ../../features/metrics/backend/src/bpu_metrics.cpp)
  target_compile_features(platform_metrics PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
  target_include_directories(platform_metrics PUBLIC ../../features/metrics/backend/include)
  target_link_libraries(platform_metrics PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
endif()
target_compile_features(r36_compare_runner PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(r36_compare_runner PRIVATE include)
target_include_directories(r36_compare_runner PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../scheduling/config/include")
target_include_directories(r36_compare_runner PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../core/runtime/include")
target_include_directories(r36_compare_runner SYSTEM PRIVATE ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(r36_compare_runner PRIVATE perception::sdk platform_metrics stereo_nv12 ${OpenCV_LIBS})
if(R36_COMPARE_WITH_HORIZON)
  if(NOT TARGET horizon_stereo)
    set(STEREO_BUILD_HORIZON_RUNNER ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(STEREO_BUILD_CODEC_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    add_subdirectory(../../features/stereo/runner "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/horizon_runner")
  endif()
  target_compile_definitions(r36_compare_runner PRIVATE R36_COMPARE_WITH_HORIZON=1)
  target_link_libraries(r36_compare_runner PRIVATE horizon_stereo)
endif()
target_link_options(r36_compare_runner PRIVATE "-Wl,--no-undefined")
foreach(directory IN LISTS PSDK_LINK_DEPENDENCY_DIRS)
  target_link_options(r36_compare_runner PRIVATE "-Wl,-rpath-link,${directory}")
endforeach()
install(TARGETS r36_compare_runner RUNTIME DESTINATION "${COMPARE_RUNNER_INSTALL_DIR}")
if(R36_COMPARE_BUILD_TESTS)
  enable_testing()
  add_executable(r36_compare_contract_test tests/contracts.cpp)
  target_compile_features(r36_compare_contract_test PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
  target_include_directories(r36_compare_contract_test PRIVATE include)
  target_include_directories(r36_compare_contract_test SYSTEM PRIVATE ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
  target_link_libraries(r36_compare_contract_test PRIVATE stereo_nv12 ${OpenCV_LIBS})
  add_test(NAME r36_compare_contract COMMAND r36_compare_contract_test)
  add_executable(r36_compare_roi_contract_test tests/comparison_roi_test.cpp)
  target_compile_features(r36_compare_roi_contract_test PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
  target_include_directories(r36_compare_roi_contract_test PRIVATE include)
  target_include_directories(r36_compare_roi_contract_test SYSTEM PRIVATE ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
  target_link_libraries(r36_compare_roi_contract_test PRIVATE ${OpenCV_LIBS})
  add_test(NAME r36_compare_roi_contract COMMAND r36_compare_roi_contract_test)
  add_executable(r36_camera_capture_contract_test tests/camera_capture_test.cpp)
  target_compile_features(r36_camera_capture_contract_test PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
  target_include_directories(r36_camera_capture_contract_test PRIVATE include
    ../../features/camera/include ../../features/camera/vendor/mo ../../core/include)
  add_test(NAME r36_camera_capture_contract COMMAND r36_camera_capture_contract_test)
endif()
